column1: workflow policy: worktreeRoot is stored only when set and must be an absolute path, in v1 and v2
workflow plan and run: worktreeRoot in the policy holds the temporary and the run worktrees, and resume reopens the run worktree there
workflow plan: a worktreeRoot inside the repository is refused with exit code 2 before any call
workflow plan: on Windows a short worktreeRoot lets a tracked path that is too long for the default worktree folder be planned
v2: worktreeRoot holds the plan and run worktrees, and the stored policy reads back without issues
